// Translated by CodeBreaker from Numbers (csharp).
using System;

namespace Corpus.Numbers
{
    public static class Program
    {
        static int Hash(string s)
        {
            int h = 17;
            foreach (char c in s)
            {
                h = h * 31 + c;
            }
            return h;
        }

        static uint Rotl(uint x, int n) => x << n | x >> 32 - n;

        public static void Main()
        {
            int big = int.MaxValue;
            big += 1;
            Console.WriteLine($"wrap {big} {unchecked(unchecked(int.MinValue - 1))}");
            try
            {
                int z = checked(int.MaxValue + Hash("x"));
                Console.WriteLine("no overflow " + z);
            }
            catch (OverflowException)
            {
                Console.WriteLine("checked overflow");
            }
            int neg = -20;
            Console.WriteLine($"shifts {neg >> 2} {neg >>> 28} {1 << 33} {1L << 33}");
            Console.WriteLine($"div {-7 / 2} {-7 % 2} {7 % -2} {-7L / 2L}");
            uint u = 4294967280u;
            u += 32;
            Console.WriteLine($"unsigned {u} {Rotl(2147483649u, 4)} {uint.MaxValue / 3u}");
            ulong ul = ulong.MaxValue;
            Console.WriteLine($"ulong {ul} {ul >> 60}");
            byte b = 250;
            b += 10;
            int i200 = 200;
            int i70000 = 70000;
            int minus1 = -1;
            sbyte sb = (sbyte)i200;
            short sh = (short)i70000;
            Console.WriteLine($"narrow {b} {sb} {sh} {(byte)minus1}");
            char c = 'A';
            c += (char)2;
            int code = c + 1;
            Console.WriteLine($"char {c} {code} {(char)(code + 1)} {(int)'z'}");
            double d = 3.99;
            double huge = 2500000000.0;
            Console.WriteLine($"conv {(int)d} {(int)(-d)} {(long)1E+18} {(int)huge}");
            long fact = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i++)
            {
                fact *= i;
            }
            Console.WriteLine($"fact20 {fact} hash {Hash("translator")}");
            int x = 7;
            x <<= 3;
            x ^= 85;
            x %= 13;
            Console.WriteLine($"compound {x} {x++ + ++x} {x}");
            Console.WriteLine($"bits {~15 & 255} {15 | 48} {6 ^ 3}");
        }
    }
}
